papers.title: Large-scale iontronic skins with neural-hierarchical processing architecture

papers.reason: 提出高密度离子电子皮肤阵列配神经分层处理架构，把快速读出与数据压缩前置到传感端，实现人形机器人精细纹理感知与轻柔操作。属触觉硬件与信号处理层，尚未接入 VLA 策略训练，但为触觉 VLA 提供上游感知基础。

papers.title: A high-dimensional population code in the bat motor cortex during natural dexterous flight
papers.abstract_snippet: Bats use their hand-like wings to reproduce natural flights with wingbeat-level precision.
